_doc: Routing engine configuration (app/services/routing_service.py). Nothing here is a transit fact: it states which interpretation rules to use when a dataset is silent. Change values here, not in code.
symmetric_sources_evidence: Dhaka_Transport_Fares lists every unordered hub pair exactly once (105 pairs for 15 hubs, none repeated in the reverse direction) with one distance/time, and the metro matrix is symmetric, so those rows describe the pair, not one direction. Co-ordination segments carry no direction information, so they are traversed origin->destination only (with a warning).
assume_reverse_note: Co-ordination segments carry no direction. Product decision: treat them as two-way so indirect trips (A->B, B->C) are found; such legs carry a DIRECTION_ASSUMED warning. Set false to traverse origin->destination only.
transfer_wait_note: No dataset provides transfer wait times; 0 is used. A session simulation may set effects.transfer_wait_min.
road_distance_factor_source: Section rule: road distance = straight-line km x 1.35 (see fare_service.ROAD_DISTANCE_FACTOR)
scenario_transfer_wait_note: Extra transfer wait per simulation scenario_type, in minutes. No dataset provides any, so it is empty (0).
